svg.text: /app/building (BuildScreen polls GET /api/v1/channels/[id] every 3 s while queued or running) · UC-04, UC-05
This takes a few minutes for a small channel and up to a couple of hours for a large one. You can close this tab: it keeps going, and
this page shows where it is when you come back.
Collecting your videos and how each audience watched
4 minutes so far · about 6 minutes left

Your channel hasn't been analysed yet

Details: extract: An error occurred during execution…
No videos to learn from yet
…needs at least one video with a complete retention curve. A video counts when it is not a
Short, is at least a week old, lasts 1 minute to 3 hours.
A build stopped before Oct 16 with usable videos shows "Ready to build" + Build now
The heading and text follow build.state; queued and running share this one.
BuildProgress: five creator-facing steps over the pipeline's eight stages (lib/build-steps.ts). The current
step shows what its stage is doing, its count from build.progress, the time so far and the ETA.
A stage being retried by the workflow shows its attempt number.
→ See your audiences / See the preview anyway → W-04
→ Start / Try again / Build now / Check again → POST /api/v1/channels/[id]/build (202 or 409), then polling
→ A 503 (builds_not_configured, fixtures_mode) shows an alert under the buttons
→ The app bar is shown; Audiences and Videos redirect back here until a summary exists
